title: Civilization studio Firaxis Games lays off a third of staff
gist: Firaxis Games (Civilization, XCOM), under 2K Games, laid off about a third of staff (~60 people) including studio head Heather Hazen after its new XCOM title missed a significant milestone, per Bloomberg. It is the studio's third troubled project in a row amid industry-wide contraction.
